title: Сквиш Мистери Дамплинги: Открой Пельмень
mechanic: Pure 4-box -> random rarity -> collection loop; no movement/combat; 36-word instructions.
interpretation: Fresh unusually broad exact-query exposure; traction proxy is promising but not breakout.

title: Станд Кейс Симулятор
mechanic: One-click case opening + inventory + upgrades + contracts + profile; Standoff-inspired.
interpretation: Very strong fresh rating accumulation but IP/theme and meta depth are likely doing substantial work.

title: Стандофф 2: Симулятор Открытия Кейсов и Боксов
interpretation: Large historical traction proxy; mature saturated Standoff case-simulator cluster.

title: Стандофф 2: Симулятор Кейсов и Боксов
interpretation: Another strong case-simulator proof point; same saturation/IP problem.

title: Распаковка Монстрикс: Коллекция Из Магазина
mechanic: Free pack -> random monster -> passive income -> pricier packs -> collection.
interpretation: Extremely cheap and directly relevant but weak rating accumulation; same developer has near-template reskins with weaker results.

title: Амнямания 2 Распаковка: Коллекция брелки
mechanic: Open pack -> random collectible -> income -> more packs -> collection.
interpretation: Near-template sibling of 524641; still weaker. Reskin factory alone is not the asymmetry.

title: Распаковывай Мемных Персонажей Фнаф Хагги Спруньки
mechanic: Click package -> reveal one of 135 meme/IP characters -> collection.
interpretation: Near-perfect low-burden loop but no observed rating traction yet; copyrighted/trend characters do not guarantee distribution.

title: Поппи Плейтайм: Сквиш Распаковка
interpretation: Pure mechanic with no observed rating traction; reinforces that opening loop without a strong hook is insufficient.

title: Кейс Симулятор Реальных Вещей
mechanic: Cases with real objects + 400 items + upgrades + tasks + minigames.
interpretation: Generic real-world theme has weak long-run rating proxy despite much higher content burden.

title: Симулятор Кейсов: Реальные Вещи
mechanic: Spend virtual cash -> random real object -> sell or keep in inventory.
interpretation: Cleaner generic real-object implementation but weak long-run traction proxy.

title: Кейс Симулятор: Машины
interpretation: Fresh strong traction proxy but driving physics and modes make it outside ultra-low-burden target.

title: Пинай Лаки Блок и Получай Брейнрот-Мобов Майна!
mechanic: Kick lucky block -> get rarity creature -> survive wave -> collection/base/progression.
interpretation: Fresh strong signal but 3D movement/progression/content burden is materially above target.

title: Будь Лаки Блоком - Получи Брейнрот!
mechanic: Become lucky block -> run risk path -> roulette reward -> escape -> base income/collection.
interpretation: Fresh strong signal and clear anticipation/reward loop; complexity means only the motif not implementation is reusable.

title: Пинай Лаки Блоки - Убегай от Цунами!
mechanic: Kick lucky block -> rare zone/brainrot -> tsunami escape -> strength/base progression.
interpretation: Strongest fresh lucky-block rating proxy in reviewed set but requires 3D/obby-style systems.

title: CatsCase
mechanic: Open cat case -> random cat -> album -> duplicate sale -> house/tasks/season pass.
interpretation: Structurally clean and original-ish but only ~5 days old at snapshot with zero ratings; useful watchlist not evidence yet.

title: Сквиши Мерж: Дамплинги и Масло
mechanic: Buy squish -> merge duplicates -> squeeze/click -> rare shiny forms -> collection.
interpretation: Appears across 14 exact-query exposures and ranks highly yet has zero ratings at ~42 days; search breadth is not demand.
